text:
Based on the image provided, it looks like there has been a mix-up. 

The image is not a "Cats of the Cosmos" chapter map or a space level selection screen; it is the **main title screen** of *The Battle Cats*. 

It features:
* A bright orange background with radiating yellow sunburst lines.
* The iconic "The Battle Cats" logo centered near the top in pink and blue letters.
* A prominent yellow "PLAY" button in the middle.
* Silhouettes of classic landmarks (like a pyramid, a pagoda/temple gate, and clouds) scattered across the middle.
* A massive crowd of the standard white Cat units packed tightly together along the very bottom edge of the screen.
* Copyright text ("© PONOS Corp.") in the top-left and a version number ("Version 12.6.0") in the top-right.
